subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should OpenClaw solve this with a global `messages.ackText` config, a non-terminal pre-dispatch plugin/channel hook, or by declaring existing progress/typing/reaction surfaces sufficient?
rationale: The current gap is real, but the fix adds config or plugin API surface across messaging channels, and repository policy sets a high bar for new config/defaults and public plugin contracts.

options.title: Design a non-terminal acknowledgement seam
options.body: Add a supported hook or channel contract that can send interim text and continue normal model dispatch, then layer config or plugins on top.

options.title: Add `messages.ackText` directly
options.body: Implement the requested global config with scope and channel/account override behavior, accepting the larger config surface.

options.title: Reject new text ack surface
options.body: Keep progress drafts, typing indicators, ack reactions, and status reactions as the intended UX and close the related broad requests.

recommendation.title: Design a non-terminal acknowledgement seam
recommendation.body: Add a supported hook or channel contract that can send interim text and continue normal model dispatch, then layer config or plugins on top.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent routing signal across reply delivery, typing, ack-reaction cleanup, and current config/docs surfaces.
